simple.summary: מְחִידָא (Mᵉchîydâʼ) means Mechida , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 52.

definitions.full: H4240. Mechida מְחִידָא proper name, masculine head of a family of returning exiles Ezra 2:52 ( ᵐ5 Μαουδα ᵐ5 L Μεειδα ) = Neh 7:54 ( ᵐ5 Μεειδα ). מִחְיָה see חיה . מְחַיָּיאֵל see מְחוּיָאֵל .
